## Claims
- [source-backed] In \(H^*(\mathrm{Gr}_{r,n})\cong\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\), \(\Lambda\) has integral Schur basis and \(I_{r,n-r}\) is spanned by \(s_\lambda\) outside \((n-r)^r\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 213-218]
- [source-backed] For \(v_{r,s,t,n}\), with \(i=s-t+1\), \(j=r-t+1\), \(a=\min(n-r-i,r-j)\), \(b=\min(i,j)\), the 2024 theorem proves minimality of \(\{\bar s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i^j,b^a)\}\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 219-235]
- [source-backed] RWY proves that the lower-adjoined and right-adjoined families generate \(J_v\) integrally; each has \(\binom{a+b}{a}\) elements. [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 864-892]
- [source-backed] The \((i,j,p,c)=(2,2,4,4)\) interval corresponds to \(n=12,r=s=6,t=5\), hence \(a=4,b=2\); the cited theorem therefore applies to the 15-element lower family \(\{\bar s_\mu:2^2\subseteq\mu\subseteq2^6\}\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 221-235; doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 878-892]
- [unsupported] The inspected sources do not provide the requested complete degreewise integral Pieri matrices, Smith diagonals, quotient free ranks, torsion factors, or complementary unimodular minors for \([2,2,0,0,0,0]\subseteq\lambda\subseteq(6^6)\).

## Strategy
Compared the supplied full-text RWY and St. Dizier–Yong sources with the specified \(c=4\) parameters. The 2024 result is an adjacent general minimality theorem, not an explicit Smith-form computation.

## Gaps
The requested \((2,2,4,4)\) computation certificate is **not established** by the inspected literature. Minimality of a 15-element generating family does not itself supply the required matrices or rule out torsion in the requested quotient presentation.
